arxiv-2301-05944.title: Knowledge is Power, Understanding is Impact: Utility and Beyond Goals, Explanation Quality, and Fairness in Path Reasoning Recommendation
arxiv-2301-05944.creator: Giacomo Balloccu, Ludovico Boratto, Christian Cancedda, Gianni Fenu, Mirko Marras (✉)
arxiv-2301-05944.description: Abstract Path reasoning is a notable recommendation approach that models high-order user-product relations, based on a Knowledge Graph (KG). This approach can extract reasoning paths between recommended products and already experienced products and, then, turn such paths into textual explanations for the user.

arxiv-2312-06196.title: SDSS-IV MaNGA: how do star-formation histories affect gas-phase abundances? 2022 SDSS-IV MaNGA: how do star-formation histories affect gas-phase abundances? – 2
arxiv-2312-06196.creator: N. Boardman, V. Wild, K. Rowlands, N. Vale Asari, Y. Luo
arxiv-2312-06196.description: Abstract Gas-phase abundances in galaxies are the products of those galaxies’ evolutionary histories. The star-formation history (SFH) of a region might therefore be expected to influence that region’s present day gaseous abundances. Here, we employ data from the MaNGA survey to explore how local gas metallicities relate to star-formation histories of galaxy regions.

arxiv-2403-15768.title: Keldysh-Lattice Boltzmann approach to quantum nanofluidics
arxiv-2403-15768.creator: Sauro Succi, Andrea Montessori
arxiv-2403-15768.description: Abstract We present a mathematical and computational framework to couple the Keldysh non equilibrium quantum transport formalism with a nanoscale lattice Boltzmann method for the computational design of quantum-engineered nanofluidic devices. 1 Introduction The general trend of modern science and engineering towards miniaturization has placed a strong premium towards the study of fluid phenomena at nanometric scales.

arxiv-2406-10753.title: Testing the parametric model for self-interacting dark matter using matched halos in cosmological simulations
arxiv-2406-10753.creator: Daneng Yang, Ethan O. Nadler, Hai-Bo Yu
arxiv-2406-10753.description: Abstract We systemically evaluate the performance of the self-interacting dark matter (SIDM) halo model proposed in Ref. [ 1 ] with matched halos from high-resolution cosmological CDM and SIDM simulations. The model incorporates SIDM effects along mass evolution histories of CDM halos and it is applicable to both isolated halos and suhbhalos.

arxiv-2509-03315.creator: Ruth H. Keogh, Karla Diaz-Ordaz, Nan van Geloven, Jon Michael Gran, Kamaryn T. Tanner
arxiv-2509-03315.description: Abstract Estimating risks or survival probabilities conditional on individual characteristics based on censored time-to-event data is a commonly faced task. arxiv-2509-11833.title: Off-Path TCP Exploits: PMTUD Breaks TCP Connection Isolation in IP Address Sharing Scenarios Conference: Proceedings of the 2025 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communications Security; October 13–17, 2025; Taipei, Taiwan. Proceedings of the 2025 ACM SIGSAC Conference on Computer and Communica
arxiv-2509-11833.creator: Xuewei Feng, Zhaoxi Li, Qi Li, Ziqiang Wang, Kun Sun, Ke Xu
arxiv-2509-11833.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Xuewei Feng, Zhaoxi Li, Qi Li, Ziqiang Wang, Kun Sun, Ke Xu. Path MTU Discovery (PMTUD) and IP address sharing are integral aspects of modern Internet infrastructure. In this paper, we investigate the security vulnerabilities associated with PMTUD within the context of prevalent IP address sharing practices. We reveal that PMTUD is inadequately designed to handle IP address sharing, creating vulnerabilities that attackers can exploit to perform off-path TCP hijacking attacks.

arxiv-2510-26143.title: Reasoning Curriculum: Bootstrapping Broad LLM Reasoning from Math
arxiv-2510-26143.creator: Bo Pang, Deqian Kong, Silvio Savarese, Caiming Xiong, Yingbo Zhou
arxiv-2510-26143.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) can elicit strong reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet most open efforts focus on math and code. We propose Reasoning Curriculum , a simple two-stage curriculum that first elicits reasoning skills in pretraining-aligned domains such as math, then adapts and refines these skills across other domains via joint RL.

arxiv-2510-27135.title: E-MMDiT: Revisiting Multimodal Diffusion Transformer Design for Fast Image Synthesis under Limited Resources
arxiv-2510-27135.creator: Tong Shen, Jingai Yu, Dong Zhou, Dong Li, Emad Barsoum
arxiv-2510-27135.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Tong Shen, Jingai Yu, Dong Zhou, Dong Li, Emad Barsoum. Diffusion models have shown strong capabilities in generating high-quality images from text prompts. However, these models often require large-scale training data and significant computational resources to train, or suffer from heavy structure with high latency. To this end, we propose Efficient Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (E-MMDiT), an efficient and lightweight multimodal diffusion model with only 304M parameters for fast image synthesis requiring low training resources. We provide an easily reproducible baseline with competitive results.

pmc-11270620.title: Next Steps: Studying Diabetic Foot Infections with Next-Generation Molecular Assays
pmc-11270620.creator: Caitlin Sande, Zoë J. Boston, Lindsay R. Kalan, Meghan B. Brennan
pmc-11270620.description: Purpose of ReviewIn 2019, the International Working Group on the Diabetic Foot voiced six concerns regarding the use of molecular microbiology techniques for routine diagnosis of infection complicating diabetic foot ulcers. The purpose of this review is to evaluate contemporary evidence addressing each of these concerns and describe promising avenues for continued development of molecular microbiology assays.

pmc-11654059.title: Sex specific differences in short-term mortality after ICU-delirium
pmc-11654059.creator: Nikolaus Schreiber, Michael Eichlseder, Simon Orlob, Christoph Klivinyi, Philipp Zoidl, Alexander Pichler, Michael Eichinger, Simon Fandler-Höfler, Laura Scholz, Jekaterina Baumgartner, Michael Schörghuber, Philipp Eller
pmc-11654059.description: IntroductionDelirium is a frequent complication in critically ill patients and is associated with adverse outcomes such as long-term cognitive impairment and increased mortality. It is unknown whether there are sex-related differences in intensive care unit (ICU) delirium and associated outcomes. We aimed to assess sex-specific differences in short-term mortality following ICU-delirium.

pmc-12704533.title: Neoehrlichia mikurensis in Ticks and Tick-Bitten Persons, Sweden and Finland, 2008–2009
pmc-12704533.creator: Emilia Hero, Malin Lager, Pia Forsberg, Per-Eric Lindgren, Anna J. Henningsson, Peter Wilhelmsson
pmc-12704533.description: By using PCR testing, we found Neoehrlichia mikurensis DNA in 1.1% of ticks removed from persons in Sweden and Finland. Symptoms developed in 2 immunocompetent persons. Despite low transmission risk, infection can occur after short tick attachment. Our findings highlight the need to consider N. mikurensis in patients with unexplained symptoms after tick bite.

pmc-12839437.creator: Mihai Adrian Socaciu, Zorita Diaconeasa, Dumitrita Rugina, Carmen Socaciu, Remus Moldovan, Simona Clichici
pmc-12839437.description: Due to their complexity, both genotypic and phenotypic, neurodegenerative diseases are one of the main causes of death globally nowadays. Among phytochemicals of high scientific interest, based on experimental studies, pentacyclic triterpenoids (TTs), including mainly betulin, betulinic, and ursolic acid, became targets of scientific research in recent years, especially in terms of their biological activity and pharmacological potential.

pmc-12866402.creator: Shoudi Hu, Zihan Shan, Xintong Shen, Shuting Tang, JiaJia Lu, Zhiyuan Wang, Guangjiao Meng, Jinzhi Li
pmc-12866402.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). pmc-13017032.title: Somatic gene mutations in the motor cortex of patients with sporadic amyotrophic lateral sclerosis
pmc-13017032.creator: Óscar González-Velasco, Rosanna Parlato, Rüstem Yilmaz, Lorena Decker, Sonja Menge, Axel Freischmidt, Xiaoxu Yang, Nikshitha Tulasi, David Brenner, Peter M Andersen, Karin M E Forsberg, Johannes C M Schlachetzki, Benedikt Brors, Lena Voith von Voithenberg, Jochen H Weishaupt
pmc-13017032.description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is characterized by the progressive degeneration of cortical and spinal motor neurons. Mendelian germline mutations often cause familial ALS (fALS) but only approximately 10% of sporadic ALS cases (sALS).We leveraged DNA and single-cell RNA sequencing data from autopsy tissue to explore the presence of somatic mosaic variants in sALS cases.

uslaw-usc-t36-s140407.title: 36 U.S.C. § 140407 — Tax-exempt status required as condition of charter
uslaw-usc-t36-s140407.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s140407.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 1404 (Military Officers Association Of America). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. If the corporation fails to maintain its status as an organization exempt from taxation under the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, the charter granted under this chapter shall terminate.
